Chapter 841: Chapter 33 Fully Understand (Subscription Request)

Chapter 841: Chapter 33 Fully Understand (Subscription Request)

Black Star Lord was emanating a vibrant vigor.

As a Level Ten of tier A, who wouldn’t long to comprehend pillar-level fusion rules of the Second Realm?

Then step into Level Eleven, from then on standing at the peak of the Cosmic Starry Skies, above countless lives and just beneath the mightiest.

Although it’s said that there are differences among Level Eleven, from first tier to sixth tier, the gap is very significant.

But at least they are at the same realm.

Lustrous Star Master sat beside, her face showing envy.

...

Hundreds of years ago, when Nalan had advanced further, she had discussed with Black Star Lord about when she could also step into that realm.

Yet in the blink of an eye, Black Star Lord had taken that step ahead, which left a bitter taste in Lustrous Star Master’s heart.

For a Level Ten of tier A to realize the pillar-level fusion rules of the Second Realm, it requires the right time, place, and people. Nalan and Black Star Lord are undoubtedly lucky.

It’s just unknown if she, the Lustrous Star Master, could also be fortunate.

“Level Eleven…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, if nothing unexpected happens, his step into Level Eleven would also be in the near future.

For any being, stepping into Level Eleven is a major transformation, second only to striving for the ultimate.

For Lin Yuan, who can endure the infusion of the Chaotic Origin, it is immensely more significant than the transition from Level Nine to Level Ten; the worlds inside his physical and Soul Body have become many times stronger.

The Chaos Void Origin he can withstand is naturally even more terrifying.

Whether enduring infusion from the Cosmic Origin Source or the Chaos Void Origin,

Both represent unprecedented great opportunities.

…

The group continued to discuss for a while, and Black Star Lord even advised Lin Yuan not to be anxious, just to proceed steadily.

Compared to other Level Ten of tier A, Lin Yuan is still young and has plenty of time to try; most Level Ten of tier A face the limit of their lifespan and tend to be anxious.

And the more anxious they are, the less likely they are to break through.

“Rumor has it… our human civilization plans to open a new Battlefield of Different Races…”

The topic shifted away from Level Eleven, and Lustrous Star Master seemed to recall something and spoke up.

“I’ve also heard about it; the new battlefield being developed is said to surpass any of the previous ones, including those over a hundred large-scale Battlefields of Different Races,”

Black Star Lord immediately spoke up; he also received related insider information.

The development of battlefields touches too many aspects; it’s hard to keep a secret.

And this time, the human civilization, in joint effort with other peak clan forces, plans to develop a battlefield,

It’s impossible not to have any whispers coming out.

“New battlefield?”

Lin Yuan listened on the side, his expression somewhat solemn.

He was also aware of this matter and even knew more details than Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master.

It was Xia Qin, a most powerful being, who mentioned it to him casually in a chat.

The new battlefield developed by human civilization, to be precise, opened in collaboration with other peak clan forces, is a super-large scale Battlefield of Different Races.

Whether in terms of direct size of the battlefield or the stability of the spatial suppression, it surpasses any large-scale Battlefield of Different Races.

One reason to develop a super-large scale Battlefield of Different Races, is something various peak clan forces have long intended to do.

As time passes, more than one hundred large battlefields have gradually become unable to sustain the skirmish among various peak-level beings.

After all, many powerful beings in the Main Universe, from the Starry Sky Races, possess the Doppelganger Skill.

This results in it being very difficult for them to die completely, especially Level Eleven beings, who can decelerate their own time flow, not only making it difficult to perish but even to just die naturally.

If high-tier beings do not perish, the lower-tier beings will gradually evolve into high-tier beings.

This is the main reason for the development of a super-large scale battlefield.

In fact, according to the exploration and understanding of past Cosmic Eras by human civilization,

Even without the Doppelganger Skill, as time passes, the universe’s powerful beings are generally increasing.

Until the end of a Cosmic Era, that’s when the universe is at its most prosperous peak.

But right after prosperity comes destruction.

With the end of the Cosmic Era, the universe collapses, and even Level Twelve supreme beings need to die at least half or even most, to escape.

And how many beings below the supreme beings can survive, depends on the tiers of the supreme beings.

Beings below Level Twelve, if they want to survive the destruction of the universe, must transfer their life imprints from the cosmic timeline to the timeline of the universe inside the body of a supreme being.

However, the number of life imprints that the universe inside a supreme being can sustain is limited.

This means that 99.9% of beings below Level Twelve will perish with the destruction of the universe.

…

The secondary reason for developing large scale battlefields… was due to the recent successive destruction of two large-scale battlefields.

A polar aurora outside the universe destroyed one large-scale battlefield, and ‘White Paper’ downgraded another large-scale battlefield.

The disappearance of two consecutive large-scale battlefields hastened human civilization and many peak clan forces to formally proceed to the implementation stage of developing a super-large scale battlefield.

Even without the collapse of these two large-scale battlefields, developing a super-large scale battlefield was just a matter of time, only delayed by a few hundred thousand or a million years.

“The new battlefield developed this time will have a very high limit, capable of accommodating Level Eleven Perfect beings wielding supreme weapons to fight freely,”

Black Star Lord said gravely.

In past large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, Level Eleven beings rarely took action, mainly Level Ten beings fought; a powerful Level Ten of tier A was sufficient to affect the outcome of a local battle zone.

Only when the intensity of the war escalates to a very high level will a large number of Level Eleven beings, up to Level Eleven Perfect beings, take action.
